summary: Pressure decline of 17.5 PSI at ST-02 correlates with overnight ambient temperature drop from 59.0°F to 42.6°F. Gas contraction reduced line pack from 6.49 to 6.46 MMSCF, mimicking a leak signature. Pressure recovered as temperature stabilized. No sustained mass balance deficit detected.

observations.label: Pressure decline at ST-02
observations.value: 763.88 → 760.82 PSI over the early morning window

observations.label: Ambient temperature drop
observations.value: 59.0°F at 03:00 → 42.6°F at 04:00 (16.4°F drop in one hour)

observations.label: Line pack contraction
observations.value: 6.4948 → 6.4626 MMSCF — consistent with gas thermal contraction

observations.label: Pressure recovery
observations.value: Recovered to 770.32 PSI by 05:15 as temperature stabilized at 64.2°F

observations.label: Mass balance deficit
observations.value: Ranged -0.028 to +0.033 MMSCFD — within normal noise, no sustained deficit

alternatives_considered.reason: Mass balance deficit resolved after temperature stabilized. No persistent gas loss. Pressure decline magnitude and timing correlate with ambient temperature change.
No compressor status change recorded at ST-02 during the investigation window.
No valve position change recorded at ST-02 during the investigation window.
